"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/calculate-money-in-leetcode-bank/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

1716. Calculate Money in Leetcode Bank

Hercy wants to save money for his first car. He puts money in the Leetcode bank every day.

He starts by putting in $1 on Monday, the first day. Every day from Tuesday to Sunday, he will put in $1 more than the day before. On every subsequent Monday, he will put in $1 more than the previous Monday.

Given n, return the total amount of money he will have in the Leetcode bank at the end of the nth day.

Example 1:

Input: n = 4
Output: 10
Explanation: After the 4th day, the total is 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 = 10.

Example 2:

Input: n = 10
Output: 37
Explanation: After the 10th day, the total is (1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 5 + 6 + 7) + (2 + 3 + 4) = 37. Notice that on the 2nd Monday, Hercy only puts in $2.

Example 3:

Input: n = 20
Output: 96
Explanation: After the 20th day, the total is (1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 5 + 6 + 7) + (2 + 3 + 4 + 5 + 6 + 7 + 8) + (3 + 4 + 5 + 6 + 7 + 8) = 96.

Constraints:

    1 <= n <= 1000
"""


class Solution:
    def totalMoney(self, n: int) -> int:
        weeks = n // 7
        days = n % 7
        # Sum of money for full weeks:
        # Each week starts with (1 + week_number) dollars on Monday
        # Sum for each week = 7 * start + sum(0..6) = 7*start + 21
        # Total for all full weeks = sum of arithmetic sequence:
        # sum_{i=1}^{weeks} (7*i + 21) = 7 * sum_{i=1}^{weeks} i + 21 * weeks
        total_full_weeks = 7 * weeks * (weeks + 1) // 2 + 21 * weeks
        # For the remaining days in the last week:
        # start money on Monday of last week = weeks + 1
        # sum of first 'days' days starting from weeks+1:
        # sum = days * start + sum(0..days-1) = days * start + days*(days-1)//2
        total_remaining_days = days * (weeks + 1) + days * (days - 1) // 2
        return total_full_weeks + total_remaining_days


sol = Solution()

print(sol.totalMoney(4))  # 10

assert sol.totalMoney(4) == 10
assert sol.totalMoney(10) == 37
assert sol.totalMoney(20) == 96

assert sol.totalMoney(1) == 1
assert sol.totalMoney(7) == 28
assert sol.totalMoney(8) == 30
assert sol.totalMoney(14) == 63
assert sol.totalMoney(15) == 66
assert sol.totalMoney(21) == 105
assert sol.totalMoney(28) == 154
assert sol.totalMoney(1000) == 74926
assert sol.totalMoney(999) == 74778
assert sol.totalMoney(13) == 55
assert sol.totalMoney(0 + 1) == 1
assert sol.totalMoney(6) == 21
